name: Video AI by Wondershare (Virbo)
summary: Virbo by Wondershare offers AI avatar videos, voiceovers, and automated video presentations from scripts. Great for marketing, courses, and content automation.
description:
Virbo by Wondershare offers AI avatar videos, voiceovers, and automated video presentations from scripts. Great for marketing, courses, and content automation.

Create stunning videos effortlessly with our AI Video Generator. Choose from 350+ realistic avatars, 400 natural voices, and 80 languages to bring your stories to life in just a few clicks.

AI avatar presenter: Choose from a variety of digital humans to star in your videos, enhancing professionalism and engagement. Script-to-video: Simply enter your text and receive a fully narrated and animated video. Custom voiceover: Upload your script and select a voice to match your brand persona or audience. Template library: Prebuilt templates for marketing, education, business, and more, making video creation fast and easy.

howToUse.title: Sign Up and Access Virbo
howToUse.description: Go to the Virbo by Wondershare website and create an account. Log in to access the dashboard.

howToUse.title: Start New Project
howToUse.description: Click 'Create Video' or use a template. Choose your desired video type (presentation, marketing, explainer, etc.).

howToUse.title: Select an AI Avatar
howToUse.description: Browse and select a digital human avatar that matches your brand or message.

howToUse.title: Write or Paste Script
howToUse.description: Enter your script for the avatar to present. Virbo supports multi-language scripts and dynamic content.

howToUse.title: Choose Voice and Language
howToUse.description: Pick a voice from the library or upload your own. Set the language, accent, and tone for your audience.

howToUse.title: Customize Video Scenes
howToUse.description: Add images, logos, backgrounds, and animations. Adjust timing and transitions for each segment.

howToUse.title: Preview and Edit
howToUse.description: Preview your video, review avatar performance, and make edits to text, voice, or visuals as needed.

howToUse.title: Export and Share
howToUse.description: Export your completed video in your chosen resolution and format. Download or share directly via link.
